points.b: A candle inside the previous one
points.t: Lower high and higher low than the bar before it.

points.b: The bar before is the "mother bar"
points.t: It sets the range the market is pausing in.

points.b: A pause, often before a push
points.t: It shows indecision. Direction comes from the break.

slides.title: Pause, then continuation
slides.text: Entry **107.25**, stop **106.05**: risk **1.20**, small because the inside bar is small. Target **109.65**.

points.t: If price breaks the other side, the idea is wrong.
Inside bars in a downtrend breaking up often fail.
Price can break one side, then the other.
The pause can last for days. Be patient or skip it.

slides.title: Small bar, small risk, clear trigger.
slides.text: Trade it with the trend, place the stop on the other side, and let the break decide.

post.instagram:
An inside bar has a lower high and a higher low than the candle before it: a pause. One way to trade it: with the trend, a buy stop just above the inside bar, a stop just below it, target 2R. Example: entry 107.25, stop 106.05, target 109.65.
